name: Leadbase
tagline: B2B lead generation, company research and contact enrichment in live sheets with sources
description:
## Leadbase: AI lead generation, company research and data enrichment

Leadbase turns a research request into a structured list you can use. Find companies, professional contacts, products or public web content, then review the results in an editable research sheet. The same workspace supports new lead lists and follow-up research on existing rows.

Use Leadbase for B2B lead generation, sales prospecting, company research, contact discovery, contact enrichment and market research. Each workflow connects your question to structured results and available source evidence, so you can check findings before using them.

For example: find independent coffee roasters in Berlin, research their official websites, then enrich the resulting company list with headquarters information. Or start with your own list and research one missing field across its existing rows.

## Build targeted company lists for B2B sales prospecting

Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language: the type of business, location, qualifying criteria, requested fields and number of results. Leadbase researches matching companies and saves each company as a separate row in a new sheet.

This supports prospect research, account discovery, territory planning, supplier discovery and market mapping. Define criteria that can be checked against public information, and ask for the sources needed to assess each match.

Useful fields can include company name, official website, location, business description and task-specific qualification notes. Fields such as employee count or current hiring activity can be researched when relevant evidence is available. Coverage depends on the information available for each business.

Requesting 100 companies means a list of company results. It does not mean adding 100 contacts to companies already in your workspace. A requested count is a target; a smaller supported result set is preferable to invented or irrelevant entries.

## Discover professional contacts and decision-makers

Research business contacts for a defined company, role, geography or target market. Specify the professional context you need, such as founders, operations leaders or purchasing contacts, and the fields that matter to your workflow.

Contact discovery builds a new people list. Contact enrichment adds researched information to people or companies already represented in a sheet. Keeping those tasks distinct helps preserve the structure of your sales data.

Ask for professional profile links, role information, business contact details and supporting sources where available. Do not assume that every person has a discoverable email address or phone number. Missing information should remain missing, and a discovered contact detail should not be described as deliverable or verified without evidence supporting that claim.

## Enrich existing company and contact data

Use an existing Leadbase sheet as the starting point for data enrichment. Research missing company websites, headquarters, business descriptions, professional roles or other defined attributes without rebuilding the list.

Enrichment can target selected rows or a column across existing rows. The column's research question determines what to find for each record. Existing values and cells with active research are skipped by the standard column-enrichment workflow.

This is useful for preparing a prospect list, improving incomplete business records and researching new attributes for an established account list. For CRM data preparation, review the enriched results and export them for your existing CRM workflow.

## Work in live, editable research sheets

Results remain in a persistent sheet, rather than disappearing into a single chat response. Open the sheet, follow research progress, inspect rows, search and filter the data, edit values and continue researching the same records.

Sheets support typed fields such as text, numbers, URLs, email addresses, phone numbers, dates, checkboxes and selection fields. Choose a type that fits the information: a website belongs in a URL field, a quantity in a number field and an explanation in a text field.

Clients with MCP Apps support can display the interactive Leadbase sheet. Available layouts and display modes depend on the host. Clients without the embedded interface can work with structured results and a link to the Leadbase sheet. The hosted workspace provides a place to review and edit the research independently of the chat interface.

## Review source evidence and research quality

Leadbase returns available source evidence with research findings. Use source links to review the original page and assess whether it supports the specific claim. Source-backed research is especially useful when comparing businesses, qualifying accounts or reviewing contact information.

A company homepage may support the official website field without supporting a precise employee count. A product image is not evidence of a current price. A missing public hiring page does not prove that a company has no vacancies. Ask for evidence appropriate to each field and retain uncertainty where the sources do not resolve it.

Source links can become unavailable and public information can change. Treat research as a documented finding that can be reviewed and updated, rather than a guarantee of permanent accuracy or complete market coverage.

## Product research and structured product lists

Use Leadbase to research products as their own result rows. Describe the product category, qualifying characteristics, source requirements and comparison fields. For example, ask for a small list of products with product names, URLs and specifications supported by the listed pages.

Product research can support sourcing, competitor research and market comparisons. Availability, specifications and prices may depend on the source and time of research; request evidence for those fields and review it before making a purchasing decision. Leadbase researches information and does not purchase products.

## Public web content and social media research

Research publicly accessible web content or public posts around a defined topic. Ask for structured fields such as title, author or organization, URL, relevant date and a short explanation of why the item matches your criteria.

This can support content discovery, topic research and competitive monitoring through individual research tasks. Access depends on what the underlying sources make available; private profiles, restricted posts and login-only content should not be assumed accessible. A dated fact should be supported by the source, rather than inferred from an ambiguous relative timestamp.

## Choose a new list, enrichment or a direct research answer

- **New list:** discover new companies, people, products or content, with one requested entity per result row.
- **Existing-sheet enrichment:** research additional attributes for selected records or a column in a sheet you already have.
- **Direct research:** answer a bounded factual question with structured findings and available sources when a persistent sheet is unnecessary.

An AI assistant should use the user's intended result to choose the workflow. Opening a workspace or reading existing results is different from starting paid research. Follow-up work should stay within the requested entities, fields and scope.

## Example research requests

**Company discovery:** “Find 10 independent coffee roasters in Berlin. Create a new sheet with one company per row, its official website and source links.”

**Sales prospecting:** “Research 20 businesses in this industry and region. Include a short explanation of how each company matches the criteria, with supporting sources.”

**Contact discovery:** “Find relevant purchasing contacts at these companies. Include professional roles, available profile links and evidence. Leave unsupported contact details empty.”

**Column enrichment:** “Fill the empty headquarters cells for every company in this sheet using official sources. Preserve the existing values.”

**Product comparison:** “Research 10 products that meet these specifications. Create a sheet with product names, source URLs and the specifications supported by those pages.”

**Public content research:** “Find public posts about this topic. Save each post as a separate row with its URL, author, supported date and a short relevance note.”

## Progress, completion and credits

Research runs in the background. An accepted request means the work has started or entered a queue; it does not mean the requested results are complete. Track progress and inspect completed, partial, failed or cancelled work before reporting the outcome.

Research consumes the connected workspace's Leadbase credits and is subject to its plan limits. Opening accessible sheets and checking the credit balance do not start paid research. A requested number of results is not a fixed price or spending cap.

Execution status and credit settlement are separate. Report final costs only once accounting is settled, and identify pending billing explicitly. After an interrupted response, recover the original operation instead of automatically starting a duplicate paid request.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Leadbase an MCP server for lead generation?

Yes. Leadbase exposes company discovery, professional contact research, data enrichment and related research workflows through a hosted Model Context Protocol service. Compatible AI assistants can request structured findings and work with persistent research sheets.

### Can Leadbase enrich an entire column?

Yes. Column enrichment can research a defined attribute across existing sheet rows. You can also limit the work to selected rows. The standard workflow skips populated values and cells that already have active research.

### Can I use Leadbase with ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or Cursor?

Leadbase uses a shared hosted MCP service for compatible clients, including ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and Cursor. Embedded sheet support depends on the client's MCP Apps capabilities. A compatible MCP connection does not by itself imply marketplace approval or identical interfaces in every host.

### Are results limited to companies and contacts?

No. New result lists can also contain products or public web content. Define the entity you want and the fields you need so the sheet matches your research task.

### Does Leadbase send outreach or synchronize my CRM automatically?

The research plugin finds and organizes information. It does not send outreach or purchase products. Review and export results for your next workflow; do not assume automatic CRM synchronization unless a separate integration explicitly provides it.

### Will every requested field and result be found?

No. Public information varies. Some fields may remain empty, some results may be partial and a search may produce fewer supported matches than requested. Review the sources and actual completion status before relying on the output.

## Start with a focused research task

Begin with a clearly defined company, contact or product research request. Specify the target market, the number of new results, the fields to collect and what sources should support them. Review the first results, then continue with enrichment in the same editable sheet.

Learn more about [Leadbase](https://www.leadbase.io/), read the [MCP documentation](https://www.leadbase.io/en/docs/settings/mcp), or visit [support](https://www.leadbase.io/en/contact).


## Access and licensing

A Leadbase account and workspace access are required. The linked repository contains the MIT-licensed public integration bundle. The hosted service and private server implementation are separate.
